name: Winter Arc walk-in stretch checklist
description: One monochrome rear-view handheld-follow take in which a fully clothed subject walks into the gym, stretches both arms overhead, lowers them, and continues deeper into the room beneath a persistent challenge checklist.
lockedGrammar: One uninterrupted natural-real-time take from a rear-view vertical handheld camera following the subject into the gym
High-contrast monochrome silhouette against a bright gym entrance
Fully clothed subject walks away from the camera into the gym while raising both arms into an overhead shoulder and triceps stretch
Subject lowers both arms and keeps walking deeper into the gym while the operator follows at a slightly slower pace
Forward camera translation, background parallax, small lateral drift and gait-synchronized vertical bob make the follow visibly handheld while keeping the subject broadly centered
Shirt, trousers and carried gym bag remain present and move causally with the walk
A centered yellow serif challenge checklist remains deterministic and persistent
No shirt removal, undressing, back reveal, bodybuilding flex, body morph, cut, locked-off camera, digital zoom or artificial stabilization
Audio is added during finishing and is independent of generated motion

variables.description: One fictional or authorized adult identity used throughout the walk-in take.
variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional athletic adult with a consistent rear silhouette and hair
examples: a fictional athletic man with short dark curls
a fictional athletic woman with a dark bun

variables.description: Gender presentation preserved through the one-take walk and stretch.
Fully clothed unbranded gym-entry outfit that remains on for the entire clip.
variables.defaultValue: a plain black T-shirt, loose dark training trousers and dark trainers
examples: a loose grey tee and black leggings

variables.description: Optional unbranded gym item carried while walking.
variables.defaultValue: a dark unbranded gym bag carried at one side

variables.description: Backlit gym entrance and visible weight room that create depth as the subject walks away.
variables.defaultValue: a gym entrance with a bright weight room beyond, mirrors and subtle background activity

variables.description: Exact deterministic heading above the challenge list.
Exact numbered challenge items rendered beneath the heading.
variables.defaultValue: 1. Water only; 2. No junk food; 3. 7-8 hours sleep; 4. Gym 4x per week; 5. Run 1x per week; 6. 10k steps daily; 7. No phone during meals; 8. 20 min outside daily; 9. Be grateful daily; 10. Track 5 daily wins

variables.description: A subtle app integration placed naturally in one tracking-oriented checklist item.
Authorized source audio or a rights-safe replacement.
variables.defaultValue: new royalty-cleared motivational audio synchronized to the walking cadence

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Show {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation from behind at the near edge of {{setting}}, fully clothed in {{wardrobe}} and carrying {{carried_item}}, as a high-contrast monochrome silhouette framed by a vertical handheld phone camera positioned a few steps behind.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Animate this as one continuous natural-real-time vertical gym take. {{subject_identity}}, fully clothed in {{wardrobe}} and carrying {{carried_item}}, walks forward into {{setting}} while a handheld phone camera follows a few steps behind. The subject raises both arms overhead for a loose shoulder and triceps stretch while still walking, lowers both arms, and continues deeper into the room. Make the rear-follow camera visibly handheld through gentle walking bob, small side-to-side drift, physical forward movement, and changing background parallax while keeping the subject broadly centered. Preserve identity, natural gait, fabric drape, carried-item swing, monochrome backlight, and gym continuity. Keep every item of clothing on throughout. No shirt removal, undressing, back reveal, bodybuilding flex, body morph, static or locked-off camera, digital zoom, cut, orbit, pan-away or artificial stabilization.
lockedTraits: forward camera translation and background parallax
subtle gait-synchronized bob and lateral drift

deterministicLayers.template: Render ‘{{checklist_title}}’ and the numbered items ‘{{checklist_items}}’ as centered yellow serif text; naturally replace the final tracking-oriented item with ‘{{product_promo}}’ when a product is requested.
Apply {{audio_policy}} without changing the locked visual timeline.

promptExamples: Use the Winter Arc walk-in stretch format with a fictional male subject and make item 10 ‘Track workouts in GymLevels’.
Create the one-take walking checklist with a fictional woman stretching overhead as she enters the gym.

notes: Corrected on 2026-09-03 after direct full-timeline source review and operator confirmation: the subject stays fully clothed, stretches overhead while walking into the gym, lowers the arms and continues forward while a handheld operator follows from behind.
The earlier analyzer and generated output incorrectly interpreted the overhead stretch as shirt removal and a flex; that output is excluded as validation evidence.
The checklist remains deterministic so product wording stays exact while photographic motion remains independently repairable.
The first corrected action A/B pair also failed because both prompts froze the camera; those outputs are excluded from validation evidence.
In the corrected handheld-follow blind pair, the operator selected Candidate A as perfect; after unsealing, A was the concise control lane, not the compiler lane.
Recipe revision 4 adopts the winning concise motion wording while preserving the v3 Fidelity Map's action, camera, lighting, continuity, timing, and deterministic-layer requirements.

The accepted run used the existing approved GPT Image 2 setup frame plus one 10-second 768P H3 Max Turbo call, seed 313086211, zero retries, and deterministic 282-frame audio-free finishing; exact evidence is persisted in fixtures/evidence/instagram-DcqCAe_Jl9o-handheld-winner-v1.json.
This validates the reusable format and production route, but the A/B result is a control win and therefore does not count as evidence that the current compiler beats a concise prompt.
The recipe transfers structure only; source identity, setting, audio, overlay rights and permissions remain separately gated.
